author: Brenton Kemp
title: JJ Bleday plays long ball Wednesday versus Phillies
desc: Reds outfielder JJ Bleday went 2-for-4 with a solo homer, an additional run, an additional RBI, and a walk in a 11-5 win over the Phillies on Wednesday.
impact: Bleday was one of several Reds to enjoy a banner evening on Wednesday, slugging a solo homer as part of a four-homer fourth inning that broke this one open. Bleday also singled and scored in the sixth inning. Despite a monster season, Bleday has cooled off a bit, as his homer and multi-hit effort on Wednesday were both firsts since June 15. Nonetheless, the former first-round pick is slashing .239/.348/.482 with 14 homers, 32 runs, 39 RBI, and three stolen bases across 63 games this season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Sal Stewart smokes pair of homers, drives in three Wednesday
desc: Reds first baseman Sal Stewart went 2-for-4 with two home runs and a walk as part of an 11-5 rout of the Phillies on Wednesday.
impact: Stewart tied the game at two with a two-run homer in the third inning before his second homer of the game, a solo shot, was part of a four-homer fourth inning for the Reds as they began to take this one over. The pair of homers gives the rookie 19 for the season, as he's also slashing .256/.341/.481 with 50 runs, 64 RBI, and 11 stolen bases on the season. He is making a strong case for National League Rookie of the Year.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Davis Martin shelled early in loss to Red Sox
desc: Davis Martin allowed five earned runs on six hits and two walks while striking out two over four innings in Wednesday's loss to the Red Sox.
impact: Martin has offered mixed results on the mound of late, allowing five earned runs or more in three of his last seven contests. The right-hander remains one of the more reliable arms in the White Sox rotation for manager Will Venable, carrying a 3.41 ERA and 1.29 WHIP with a 9-4 record and 8.3 K/9 ratio through 17 starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Aaron Judge (rib) to be re-imaged during All-Star break
desc: Yankees GM Brian Cashman said Aaron Judge will be re-imaged during All-Star break.
impact: The Yankees remain optimistic that Judge will return at some point this season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Elly De La Cruz homers, scores three times in rout of Phillies
desc: Reds shortstop Elly De La Cruz went 2-for-3 with a homer, a double, two additional runs scored, and a pair of walks in an 11-5 rout of the Phillies on Wednesday.
impact: The Reds busted out in a big way on Wednesday, just a day after Zack Wheeler struck out 14 on them. De La Cruz popped a two-run homer as part of a four-homer inning the fourth while adding a double and two additional runs scored to his ledger. The big night has the superstar slashing .274/.349/.488 with 14 home runs, 47 runs, 43 RBI, and 13 stolen bases across 72 games this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Connor Prielipp (blister) placed on IL
desc: The Twins placed LHP Connor Prielipp on the 15-day injured list with a blister.
impact: Prielipp suffered the injury in his most recent start. He'll look to return shortly after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bailey Ober (elbow) activated from IL
desc: The Twins activated Bailey Ober from the injured list.
impact: Ober makes his return to the mound for Minnesota on Thursday against the Guardians. He remains off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kendry Rojas recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Twins recalled LHP Kendry Rojas from Triple-A St. Paul.
impact: Rojas has a 1.65 ERA in 16 1/3 innings for the Twins this season. He'll likely hold a long relief role.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Jake Rogers homers in win over Athletics Wednesday
desc: Tigers catcher Jake Rogers went 2-for-2 with a two-run homer and an additional run scored in a 6-1 win over the Athletics on Wednesday.
impact: All-Star catcher Dillon Dingler started behind the plate for the Tigers on Wednesday, but took a foul tip off the hand in the second innings. As a result, Rogers entered the game and promptly clubbed a two-run homer in his first at-bat of the contest. He added a single and scored on Spencer Torkelson's three-run homer in the fifth frame. Due to Dingler's meteoric rise this season, Rogers hasn't seen much playing time, slashing .160/.239/.284 with two homers, nine runs, eight RBI, and a stolen base through just 93 trips to the plate.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tim Herrin (elbow) placed on IL
desc: The Guardians placed Tim Herrin on the 15-day injured list.
impact: Herrin took a comebacker off his pitching elbow during Wednesday's game against the Twins. He does not hold a timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cooper Ingle optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Guardians optioned Cooper Ingle to Triple-A Columbus.
impact: Ingle will return to Triple-A with Petey Halpin recalled as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Codi Heuer recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Guardians recalled Codi Heuer from Triple-A Columbus.
impact: Heuer will hold a middle-relief role with Tim Herrin placed on the injured list.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Troy Melton continues to roll in win over Athletics Wednesday
desc: Tigers right-hander Troy Melton allowed just one unearned run on four hits and one walk across 5 1/3 innings, earning the win over the Athletics on Wednesday.
impact: Melton largely cruised through Wednesday's outing, striking out a career-high nine on the evening, including striking out the side in the fifth inning. A Zach McKinstry throwing error in the fourth inning accounted for the lone run against Melton and Tigers pitching on Wednesday. Melton has now allowed one or fewer earned runs in four straight starts, while he has yielded two earned runs or fewer in seven of his eight starts this season. He will carry a tidy 1.82 ERA into the All-Star break and is quickly becoming a fixture in the Tigers' rotation for years to come.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Petey Halpin recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Guardians recalled Petey Halpin from Triple-A Columbus.
impact: Halpin will add depth in the outfield for Cleveland heading into the final few games before the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Vinnie Pasquantino (hand) could be activated Friday
desc: Royals manager Matt Quatraro said Vinnie Pasquantino could return on Friday.
impact: Pasquantino has been on the injured list since June 14 with a right hamate fracture.
